plan_dict.goal: Fix speech balloon vertical text alignment and centroid centering on Web Canvas to achieve visual parity with PSD and image export
plan_dict.markdown:
### Phase 1 — Smart Balloon Centroid Alignment
- [ ] Update positionAtCentroid in frontend/src/utils/smartBalloonCanvas.ts to accept and compute actualTextHeight.
- [ ] Update Canvas.tsx existing textbox updates to pass actualTextHeight into positionAtCentroid.
- [ ] Update Canvas.tsx new textbox creation to pass actualTextHeight into positionAtCentroid.

### Phase 2 — Standard Balloon Vertical Alignment & Offset
- [ ] In Canvas.tsx, calculate topOffset = Math.max(0, (height - actualTextHeight) / 2) when vertical_align === "center".
- [ ] Apply top = y + topOffset for standard balloons with canonical spec.
- [ ] Verify autoFitTextboxFontSize binary search coordinates.

### Phase 3 — Unit & Regression Tests
- [ ] Add unit tests in frontend/src/tests/typesetting.test.ts verifying centroid centering and vertical offset calculations.
- [ ] Run backend pytest suites (test_smart_balloon_v15.py and test_smart_balloon_font_size_mode.py).

### Phase 4 — Long real playtest / soak (ใช้งานเล่นจริงยาวๆ)
- [ ] Run full interactive test in web app with real manga pages containing Spiky, Oval, and Narrative balloons.
- [ ] Perform drag, resize, rotate, and text editing operations to ensure no visual drift.

### Phase 5 — Capture stepwise screenshots (~8–10 visual_step)
- [ ] Capture step-by-step screenshots of single-line, 2-line, 3-line Thai text across various balloon archetypes.

### Phase 6 — AI inspect captures (visual_critic / VisionBridge)
- [ ] Verify text vertical centering against balloon contours and backend PNG export rendering.

### Phase 7 — Visual recheck pass (เช็คอีกรอบ)
- [ ] Second verification pass on conjoined balloons and edge-case text templates.

steps.1_goal: Fix the vertical positioning and text centering issue on the Web Editor Canvas (Fabric.js) where translation text appears pinned to the top edge of speech balloons with excessive empty space below, achieving 100% visual parity across Web Canvas, Pillow Renderer, and Photoshop PSD export.
steps.2_constraints: Zero Drift with backend renderer (renderer.py) and PSD CLI (export.rs). Polygon Centroid Integrity for Smart Balloons. Fabric.js Textbox compatibility without breaking text editing. Interactive transform stability.
steps.3_stakeholders: Translators, typesetters, manga scanlation editors, and QA teams.
steps.4_current_state: In Canvas.tsx positionAtCentroid passes bounding box height (307px) instead of actualTextHeight. smartBalloonCanvas.ts sets top = cy - height/2 which places top at the top edge of balloon. Fabric Textbox draws from top down leaving bottom empty. Standard balloons place top = y without (height - actualTextHeight)/2 offset.
steps.5_options: Option A (Golden Architecture): Calculate actualTextHeight via Fabric calcTextHeight and set top = cy - actualTextHeight/2 for Smart Balloon, and top = y + (height - actualTextHeight)/2 for standard balloons. Option B: Override _renderTextLines (flawed, breaks cursor). Option C: Wrap in fabric.Group (overkill, high overhead).
steps.6_chosen_design: Implement Option A: Update positionAtCentroid in smartBalloonCanvas.ts and Canvas.tsx, apply vertical offset for standard balloons, and synchronize auto-fit baseline.
steps.8_test_plan: MUST include: (1) long real playtest/soak while app runs; (2) ~8–10 gk_evidence.visual_step captures; (3) visual_critic/VisionBridge inspect each shot; (4) visual recheck pass. Then unit/integration tests with npm test and pytest.
steps.9_rollout_verify: Compare Canvas rendered text position vs PIL renderer.py PNG output and PSD export pixel-for-pixel on sample pages.

evidences.summary: 5 Web research queries proving Fabric.js text vertical centering math and speech balloon centroid placement

payload.findings: Fabric.js Textbox lacks vertical centering and starts text from top. Centroid placement must use real text height (cy - actualTextHeight/2), and standard speech balloons must offset top by (height - actualTextHeight)/2.
